data.narrative:
Ayar Labs, a Series E-stage AI & Software company founded by Mark Wade and Vladimir Stojanovic, is currently valued at $3.75B post-money after raising $870M+. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR), with same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers including Applied Intuition ($15.0B, Series F), Wayve ($8.6B, Series D), and SandboxAQ ($5.8B, Series E).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.4x step-up multiplier from the current $3.8B post-money valuation to the next funding round, implying $5.2B. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $8.6B, with a range of $5.8B to $15.0B. The peer-median method carries greater weight given the direct comparability of the sample.

The two methods triangulate to a valuation range of $4.5B (low) to $9.9B (high), with a median of $6.9B. The current $3.75B valuation sits materially below this range, reflecting either a discount relative to peer progression or stage-specific risk factors. Key uncertainties include the timing and terms of the next funding event, relative performance trajectory versus Applied Intuition and Wayve, and market sentiment shifts in frontier AI valuations.
